# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Sunday, November 1, 2026

*Sunday, Nov 1, 2026 edition. Indian markets were shut Saturday and today, so equity, index, rupee and flow numbers are Friday's (30 Oct) close. Spot gold is this morning's 07:10 IST quote; MCX gold is Friday's late-evening print (23:42 IST); Brent is Friday's settlement. The big new item is Muthoot Finance's Q2, which came out on Saturday. Muthoot Finance Ltd is a separate listed company from Muthoot Fincorp Ltd. Regulatory headlines only; the deep dive is in the Rules report.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

**1. Muthoot Finance grew fast in Q2 and raised its gold-loan guidance, but its bad loans jumped.**
- Standalone Q2 FY27 PAT **₹2,977 cr (+27%)**; consolidated PAT **₹3,278 cr (+36%)**. Standalone loan AUM **₹1,87,810 cr**, up 42% year on year and 9% quarter on quarter; standalone gold-loan AUM ₹1,78,956 cr (+43%). Results were declared on Saturday, 31 Oct. ([NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/muthoot-finance-q2-results-profit-rises-27-to-rs-2-977-crore-revises-gold-loan-growth-guidance-for-fy27-12263278), [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-results-net-profit-rises-27-to-rs2978-crore-nii-up-34-beats-estimates-20024053.htm), [ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-cons-profit-jumps-36-yoy-to-rs-3278-crore/articleshow/135401237.cms))
- MD Alexander George Muthoot said the company is raising FY27 gold-loan growth guidance "by an additional 10%", and that the RBI's gold-lending rules effective 1 April 2026 involve a learning curve for the company as well as for customers, which he expects to stabilise over a few quarters. ([NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/muthoot-finance-q2-results-profit-rises-27-to-rs-2-977-crore-revises-gold-loan-growth-guidance-for-fy27-12263278))
- Standalone gross NPA (Stage 3) rose to **3.87% from 2.28%** three months earlier. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-cons-profit-jumps-36-yoy-to-rs-3278-crore/articleshow/135401237.cms)) Cofacto's read of the filing puts the quarter's impairment charge at ₹514.92 cr and provision coverage at 11.80%. ([Cofacto](https://cofacto.ai/market-news/muthootfin-q2-fy27-results-analysis))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** This is the closest public read on what the new RBI gold-loan rules did to a large gold-loan book in Q2. A Stage 3 rise of about 160 bp in one quarter at the largest player is likely to prompt similar questions for other gold lenders, including Muthoot Fincorp, when their Q2 numbers come out.

**2. Gold-loan stress is now showing up across the sector, not at one lender.**
- Shriram Finance said on 23 Oct that gross Stage 3 in its gold book rose to **3.12% from 2.57%** a quarter earlier. Bajaj Finance flagged a rise in 30+ day overdues partly driven by short-term gold loans it has stopped offering, and Piramal Finance called fast gold-loan growth an emerging risk. ([VCCircle/Reuters](https://www.vccircle.com/shriramfinance-joins-peers-in-flagging-stress-in-gold-loans))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Three diversified lenders plus Muthoot Finance now point the same way. The common thread in the coverage is the April 2026 rules (renewal only after interest is cleared, bullet tenor caps), which push some loans overdue that used to be rolled, so the split between technical overdue and real collection problems is likely to matter in comparisons across gold lenders, including Muthoot Fincorp.


**3. Gold steadied this morning after Friday's 3% fall; oil is still near $118.**
- Spot gold was **$3,875.40 (+0.06%)** at 07:10 IST today, after falling 3.04% to $3,899.33 on Friday. ([exa.ai XAUUSD](https://exa.ai/library/markets/commodity/gold?currency=USD), [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/commodities/gold-silver-prices-crash-mcx-gold-plunges-to-rs-1-lakh-silver-falls-to-rs-1-lakh-per-kg-20023794.htm))
- December Brent settled at **$117.64 (+2.4%)** on Friday, a six-month high, after a tanker was mined in the Strait of Hormuz. ([Reuters via Euronext](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/oil-jumps-2-settles-6-month-highs-fears-escalation-iran))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Collateral value is roughly where it was on Friday night. Oil keeps a December Fed hike priced in, which feeds NBFC borrowing costs, including Muthoot Fincorp's.

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Last reported status: bids stood at 1.86 times the ₹200 cr base issue at 17:00 IST on Fri 30 Oct (retail 1.60×, HNI 2.56×, non-institutional 1.29×, institutional 0.00×). The issue is ₹200 cr base plus ₹300 cr green shoe, allotted first come, first served, and closes Thu 5 Nov. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))
- **Subsidiary.** Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, holds its Q2 board meeting on 5 Nov. ([StockFin](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/MUTHOOTMF/2026-10-23/board-meeting))

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

- **Friday 30 Oct close:** Sensex **74,459.53 (+308.49, +0.42%)**, Nifty **23,053.10 (+116.35, +0.51%)**. Both rose nearly 2% over the week. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-30th-october-2026/article71640574.ece))
- **Financials:** Nifty Financial Services **24,712.20 (+0.03%)**, Nifty Bank 54,686.95 (−0.41%). ([NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_30102026.csv))
- **NBFC peers, NSE close 30 Oct:** Manappuram **₹289.00 (−4.34%)**, Muthoot Finance **₹2,408.60 (−3.54%)**, IIFL Finance **₹527.65 (−6.15%)**, Shriram Finance **₹823.15 (−2.13%)**, Bajaj Finance **₹939.10 (+0.02%)**. Muthoot Finance's results came after this close, so Monday is the first reaction. ([exa.ai NSE closes](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MANAPPURAM?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-30&view=daily), [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-results-net-profit-rises-27-to-rs2978-crore-nii-up-34-beats-estimates-20024053.htm))
- **Week:** Shriram Finance was the worst Nifty 50 stock of the week (−4.84%). ([Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/markets-next-week-will-the-earnings-driven-recovery-continue-amid-elevated-crude-prices-564914-2026-11-01))
- **Flows (30 Oct, provisional):** FIIs net bought **₹3,598.54 cr**; DIIs net sold **₹817.51 cr**. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/fiis-return-to-buying-indian-stocks-with-rs3599-crore-inflows-diis-turn-net-sellers-20023622.htm))
- **Rupee:** **94.93/$ (provisional), up 33 paise** on Friday. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-30th-october-2026/article71640574.ece))

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

- **RBI:** nothing new since the 30 Oct batch covered yesterday. The press-release page shows no releases dated 31 Oct. The central board's 625th meeting on 30 Oct reviewed the economy, risks to the outlook and DICGC's working. ([RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx), [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63892))
- **SEBI:** no circulars after 30 Oct. ([SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0))
- **IBBI:** no circulars after the two real-estate circulars of 30 Oct. ([IBBI](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars))
- More detail on the Rules page.

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

- **Muthoot Finance, Q2 FY27:** NII **₹5,365 cr (+34.4%)**, above the CNBC-TV18 poll of ₹4,525 cr. H1 consolidated PAT ₹6,103 cr (+39%). Active customers 69 lakh (from 64 lakh); gold in its lockers 204 tonnes (from 196). ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-results-net-profit-rises-27-to-rs2978-crore-nii-up-34-beats-estimates-20024053.htm))
- **Muthoot Finance subsidiaries:** Muthoot Money loan AUM ₹12,716 cr (+99%), H1 PAT ₹364 cr; Belstar Microfinance H1 PAT ₹144 cr against a ₹160 cr loss a year ago; Muthoot Homefin AUM ₹3,460 cr. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-results-net-profit-rises-27-to-rs2978-crore-nii-up-34-beats-estimates-20024053.htm))
- **Spandana Sphoorty, Q2 FY27 (30 Oct):** back to profit at **₹18.2 cr** consolidated, against a ₹249 cr loss a year earlier; revenue +41.3% to ₹325 cr. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/spandana-sphoorty-returns-to-profit-at-rs-18-crore-in-q2fy27/articleshow/135369091.cms), [Alfafinder](https://news.alfafinder.com/news/spandana-sphoorty-q2-27-consolidated-results-turnaround/))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Belstar and Spandana both say microfinance is healing, which is relevant to Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's subsidiary, whose board meets on 5 Nov.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

- **Crisil upgraded Navi Finserv to A+/Stable from A/Stable** (short term A1+ from A1) and rated its new ₹500 cr NCD, on 29 Oct. Navi's AUM was ₹23,440 cr in June 2026, about 93% digital personal loans. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/finance/crisil-upgrades-navi-finserv-rating-assigns-rating-rs-500-crore-ncd-issue-20022547.htm))
- No other NBFC rating action verified since Friday.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

- **Muthoot Finance** board approved merging wholly owned subsidiary Muthoot Money into the parent, with 1 April 2027 as the appointed date, subject to approvals. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-results-net-profit-rises-27-to-rs2978-crore-nii-up-34-beats-estimates-20024053.htm)) Cofacto notes it still needs NCLT Kochi and RBI approval. ([Cofacto](https://cofacto.ai/market-news/muthootfin-q2-fy27-results-analysis))

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

- No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- **Muthoot Finance:** standalone Stage 3 **3.87%** (2.28% in June). ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-cons-profit-jumps-36-yoy-to-rs-3278-crore/articleshow/135401237.cms))
- **Belstar Microfinance:** GNPA 3.26% (4.58% a year ago); collection efficiency 99.61%. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-results-net-profit-rises-27-to-rs2978-crore-nii-up-34-beats-estimates-20024053.htm))
- **Shriram Finance gold book:** Stage 3 3.12% (2.57% in June). ([VCCircle/Reuters](https://www.vccircle.com/shriramfinance-joins-peers-in-flagging-stress-in-gold-loans))

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

- **Equitas SFB:** MD & CEO P N Vasudevan resigned on 29 Oct, citing a perceived conflict of interest because his daughter co-promotes Unico Housing Finance. He stays until a successor is in place. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/equitas-sfb-md-amp-ceo-p-n-vasudevan-resigns-citing-perception-of-conflict-of-interest-stock-down-20/article71640049.ece), [Financial Express](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/news/equitas-sfb-to-find-vasudevans-successor-in-a-month/4373199/))
- **Hinduja Housing Finance** named Vivek Kannan CEO; **Veritas Finance** named Mathew Joseph non-executive chairman (both 30 Oct). ([BusinessLine live, 30 Oct](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-30th-october-2026/article71640574.ece))

## 🏭 Sector Deep Dive — Sunday: Weekly preview + sector health check

**1. The week ahead.**
- **Mon 2 Nov:** first trading day after Muthoot Finance's results; US PMI. **Tue 3 Nov:** US midterm elections; SBI, Bajaj Finserv and MCX results. **Wed 4 Nov:** BSE results. **Thu 5 Nov:** LIC and Titan results; Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD issue closes; Muthoot Microfin board. **Fri 6 Nov:** US jobs data. ([Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/markets-next-week-will-the-earnings-driven-recovery-continue-amid-elevated-crude-prices-564914-2026-11-01))
- Titan's numbers are the best read on retail gold-jewellery demand at these prices, which is the other side of the gold-loan collateral story.

**2. Health check: growth is as strong as expected.**
- Before the season, JM Financial expected aggregate NBFC AUM growth of about 20% and 27% for gold, MSME and LAP lenders. ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/nbfc-aum-growth-seen-at-20-in-q2fy27-funding-costs-emerge-as-key-risk/134720832)) Muthoot Finance's 42% standalone AUM growth ran well ahead of that.

**3. Health check: asset quality is where the surprise came.**
- The same preview expected only a "marginal increase in credit costs". ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/nbfc-aum-growth-seen-at-20-in-q2fy27-funding-costs-emerge-as-key-risk/134720832)) Instead gold-loan Stage 3 rose at Muthoot Finance and Shriram, and Bajaj and Piramal flagged gold-loan risk. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-cons-profit-jumps-36-yoy-to-rs-3278-crore/articleshow/135401237.cms), [VCCircle/Reuters](https://www.vccircle.com/shriramfinance-joins-peers-in-flagging-stress-in-gold-loans))

**4. Health check: funding is the slow squeeze.**
- JM Financial noted three- and five-year AAA NBFC bond yields up 50–60 bp since June. ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/nbfc-aum-growth-seen-at-20-in-q2fy27-funding-costs-emerge-as-key-risk/134720832)) The benchmark 10-year G-sec closed at 7.3902% on Thursday, though it eased about 8.5 bp over the week, and markets put the odds of a December Fed hike at about 83%. ([BusinessLine live, 30 Oct](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-30th-october-2026/article71640574.ece))

> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** The market is rewarding gold-loan growth, but this week the questions for gold lenders, including Muthoot Fincorp, are about Stage 3 and how the April rules flow through it. Gold is about 3% below Thursday's level and steady overnight.

reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Sunday, 1 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No new RBI/SEBI circulars or regulatory changes related to NBFCs were found today.

RBI, SEBI and IBBI have published nothing NBFC-relevant since the 30 Oct batch, which was covered and logged yesterday.

### What is in the market that is *not* an NBFC circular

| Item | What it actually is |
|------|---------------------|
| **Muthoot Finance Q2 FY27, 31 Oct.** Standalone gross NPA **3.87%**, up from 2.28% in June. The MD said the RBI gold-lending guidelines effective 1 April 2026 involve a learning curve for the company and its customers that should stabilise over a few quarters. | Company results and management commentary, not regulation. [ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/muthoot-finance-q2-cons-profit-jumps-36-yoy-to-rs-3278-crore/articleshow/135401237.cms), [NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/muthoot-finance-q2-results-profit-rises-27-to-rs-2-977-crore-revises-gold-loan-growth-guidance-for-fy27-12263278) |
| **RBI PR (30 Oct): 625th Central Board meeting** reviewed the economy, risks to the outlook, DICGC and select departments | Board meeting note. [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63892) |
| **RBI drafts** | Latest still **11 Sep** (KYC). [Drafts](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx) |

Primary sources checked this morning (IST):
- [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx): latest 30 Oct (RBI/2026-27/303).
- [RBI Press Releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx): latest 30 Oct; nothing dated 31 Oct.
- [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0): latest 30 Oct.
- [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars): latest 30 Oct (IBBI/CIRP/109 and 110/2026).

---

## ⏰ What did *not* move overnight

| Item | Status | Next date |
|------|--------|-----------|
| **Q2 FY27 / LODR 52** | Books frozen at 30 Sep. | **14 Nov 2026** (13 days) |
| **Credit Risk-o-Meter** | Issued 7 Oct; goes live 45 days later. | **21 Nov 2026** (20 days) |
| Revolving-credit draft (6 Aug) | Still a draft. | Final expected around Nov 2026 |
| Interest Rate Directions draft (12 Aug) | Comments closed 11 Sep. | **1 Apr 2027** if finalised |
| **IBC CIIRP (Chapter IV-A)** | Section 40 of the 2026 Act still not notified. | Waiting for a commencement notice |
| Type I deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability | Window open. | **31 Dec 2026** (60 days) |
| Recovery agents (RBC 3rd Amendment) | Certification, calling window, call recording. | **1 Jan 2027** (61 days) |
| **Internal Ombudsman quarterly return (Oct–Dec)** | Due by the 15th after quarter-end (para 16(2)). [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13274&Mode=0) | **15 Jan 2027** (75 days) |

---

## 📅 Regulatory calendar

- **14 Nov 2026:** last date for Q2 FY27 results of listed debt issuers under SEBI LODR Regulation 52.
- **21 Nov 2026:** SEBI Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure applies to new debt offer documents.
- **31 Dec 2026:** Type I NBFC deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability window closes.
- **1 Jan 2027:** recovery-agent requirements under the RBC Third Amendment take effect.
- **1 Apr 2027:** Interest Rate Directions take effect, if finalised.
- **15 Jan 2027:** Internal Ombudsman quarterly return for Oct–Dec due ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13274&Mode=0)).
- **27 Apr 2027:** debenture trustees' deadline to ring-fence non-SEBI business.
- **30 Sep 2027:** last date to reverse unrealised pre-SNFA interest on legacy SNFA stock.

cards.title: Muthoot Finance grew fast in Q2 and raised its gold-loan guidance, but its bad loans jumped.
cards.summary: Standalone Q2 FY27 PAT ₹2,977 cr (+27%) ; consolidated PAT ₹3,278 cr (+36%) . Standalone loan AUM ₹1,87,810 cr , up 42% year on year and 9% quarter on quarter; standalone gold-loan AUM ₹1,78,956 cr (+43%).
cards.impact: This is the closest public read on what the new RBI gold-loan rules did to a large gold-loan book in Q2. A Stage 3 rise of about 160 bp in one quarter at the largest player is likely to prompt similar questions for other gold lenders, including Muthoot Fincorp, when their Q2 numbers come out.

cards.title: Gold-loan stress is now showing up across the sector, not at one lender.
cards.summary: Shriram Finance said on 23 Oct that gross Stage 3 in its gold book rose to 3.12% from 2.57% a quarter earlier. Bajaj Finance flagged a rise in 30+ day overdues partly driven by short-term gold loans it has stopped offering, and Piramal Finance called fast gold-loan growth an emerging risk.
cards.impact: Three diversified lenders plus Muthoot Finance now point the same way. The common thread in the coverage is the April 2026 rules (renewal only after interest is cleared, bullet tenor caps), which push some loans overdue that used to be rolled, so the split between technical overdue and real collection problems is likely to matter in comparisons across gold lenders, including Muthoot Fincorp.

cards.title: Gold steadied this morning after Friday's 3% fall; oil is still near $118.
cards.summary: Spot gold was $3,875.40 (+0.06%) at 07:10 IST today, after falling 3.04% to $3,899.33 on Friday. (exa.ai XAUUSD, CNBC-TV18) - December Brent settled at $117.64 (+2.4%) on Friday, a six-month high, after a tanker was mined in the Strait of Hormuz.
cards.impact: Collateral value is roughly where it was on Friday night. Oil keeps a December Fed hike priced in, which feeds NBFC borrowing costs, including Muthoot Fincorp's.
